load_distributed_state_dict: load a distributed state_dict from a FileSystemReader checkpoint in SPMD style across ranks
load_state_dict_deprecated: load a deprecated state_dict using load_state_dict with a storage reader and optional process group
load_state_dict_no_dist: load a checkpoint without distributed coordination by passing no_dist=True to load
load_state_dict_with_planner: load a state_dict using a custom LoadPlanner for plan customization during checkpoint restore
load_state_dict_stateful_objects: load a state_dict containing Stateful objects that call state_dict and load_state_dict hooks around deserialization
